title: E-LINK EL-216PS 16-Port 2 Gigabit Uplink POE Switch

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The E-LINK EL-216PS 16-Port 2 Gigabit Uplink PoE Switch is a high-power, reliable, and cost-effective networking solution designed for IP cameras, wireless access points, VoIP phones, and small to medium business networks. Featuring 16 PoE ports, 2 Gigabit uplink ports, and 1 Gigabit SFP fiber uplink, this switch ensures fast data transmission, stable power delivery, and seamless network expansion.

Its strong PoE power budget and surge protection make it ideal for CCTV, ISP, office networks, and smart home installations.


Key Features


  • 16 × 10/100Mbps PoE Ports for powering IP cameras, APs, VoIP, and IoT devices
  • 2 × 10/100/1000Mbps RJ45 Gigabit Uplink Ports for routers, NVRs, and backbone links
  • 1 × 100/1000Mbps SFP Uplink Port for fiber connectivity
  • Supports IEEE 802.3af / 802.3at PoE+, up to 30W per port
  • High PoE Power Budget (Up to 240W) for multiple high-power devices
  • 6kV/8kV Surge Protection ensures stable operation in challenging environments
  • Plug-and-Play unmanaged design for quick setup
  • Store-and-Forward Switching for improved data reliability
  • Ideal for CCTV environments, FTTH/ISP networks, office LAN, and wireless deployments
